# Online Tutorials

> A comprehensive platform offering free online courses and tutorials across software development, office productivity, business, health, and personal development.

Online Tutorials aggregates educational content spanning programming frameworks (React, Angular, Vue.js), Microsoft Office applications, cybersecurity, and professional skills development. The platform serves as a course directory with curated tutorials from beginner to advanced levels across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft Excel
- JavaScript
- Web Development
- React
- Git Version Control
- Java SDK
- Office Productivity
- Ethical Hacking
- Leadership Development
- Data Analysis
- Course Directory
- Beginner-to-Advanced
- Online Courses
- Skill Learning
- Tutorial

## Web Development & Programming

- [Build your first React JS Application](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/development/build-your-first-react-js-application): Beginner tutorial for building first React JS web application.
- [React vs Angular vs Vue.js by Example](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/development/react-vs-angular-vs-vue-js-by-example): Comparison guide for React, Angular, and Vue.js JavaScript frameworks.
- [Git Crash Course: Version Control For Software Developers](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/development/git-crash-course-version-control-for-software-developers): Crash course on Git version control using command line and GitHub tools.
- [TestProject Java SDK Tutorial](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/development/testproject-java-sdk-tutorial): Tutorial for TestProject Java SDK with cross-browser automation testing.

## Office Productivity & Data Analysis

- [Microsoft Excel Complete Course | All in one MS Excel Course](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/office-productivity/microsoft-excel-complete-course-all-in-one-ms-excel-course): Comprehensive Excel course from basic to advanced level.
- [Zero to Hero in Microsoft Excel: Complete Excel guide 2021](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/office-productivity/zero-to-hero-in-microsoft-excel-complete-excel-guide-2023): Beginner to advanced Excel guide with formulas, charts, and macros.
- [Microsoft Excel 101- Excel From Beginners to Advanced](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/office-productivity/microsoft-excel-101-excel-from-beginners-to-advanced): Complete Excel guide covering formulas, functions, and automation.
- [Learn Microsoft Excel Charts (Basic to Advanced)](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/office-productivity/learn-microsoft-excel-charts-basic-to-advanced): Tutorial for creating Excel charts from basic to advanced levels.
- [Excel Functions - The Essentiel To Know](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/office-productivity/excel-functions-the-essentiel-to-know): Tutorial on essential Excel functions and when to use them.

## Business & Professional Development

- [The Complete Leadership Mastery Course](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/business/the-complete-leadership-mastery-course): Leadership and management training course for professional development.
- [Business idea generation to launch - a case study analysis](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/teaching-academics/business-idea-generation-to-launch-a-case-study-analysis): Case study guide on entrepreneurship and business launch process.

## IT & Cybersecurity

- [Network Ethical Hacking for Beginners (Kali 2020, Hands-on)](https://www.onlinetutorials.org/it-software/network-ethical-hacking-for-beginners-kali-2020-hands-on): Hands-on ethical hacking course using Kali Linux for network security.
